document.title: Space exploration or problems on Earth
document.question:
Some people believe that governments should continue to spend large amounts of money on space exploration. Others argue that this money would be better spent on solving problems here on Earth.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
